paragraphs: Beparasha zo lo katabti halakot beshana sheniyya yaan ki lidrosh beparasha zo behilkot chanukka bekol shana veshana:

clarification.explanation: For this parasha (Vayeshev) I did not write halachot for the second year, since I preach on this parasha every year with the laws of Chanukah instead.
takeaways: Vayeshev (second year) is devoted each year to the laws of Chanukah in place of the regular series of halachot
